intents.title: Forecasting and estimation
intents.question: How can I make forecasts and estimates without letting one vivid case or target number dominate?
intents.description: Reviewed lenses for forecasts, estimates, probability judgments and future choices.

intents.title: AI-assisted decisions
intents.question: How should I check a decision when an AI system is influencing the answer?
intents.description: Evidence-aware checks for automation, anchoring, humanlike interfaces and repeated AI claims.

intents.title: Checking claims and information
intents.question: How can I check a claim without confusing familiarity, repetition or disagreement with evidence?
intents.description: Reviewed lenses for misinformation, corrections, source checking and belief updating.

intents.title: Project and product decisions
intents.question: How can a team review a project or product choice without letting outcomes or past investment rewrite the decision?
intents.description: Reviewed lenses for delivery, metrics, escalation, sunk cost and retrospective project judgment.

intents.title: KPIs, proxy metrics and benchmarks
intents.question: How can I tell whether a KPI or benchmark is still measuring the goal instead of becoming the goal?
intents.description: Reviewed lenses for proxy metrics, targets, benchmark scores, measurement quality and goal substitution.

intents.title: Social judgment and perspective
intents.question: How can I separate what I know, what another person knows and what I infer about their competence or responsibility?
intents.description: Reviewed lenses for perspective taking, self-assessment, attribution and social judgment.

intents.title: Sunk cost and continuation decisions
intents.question: Should I continue because the next step is worthwhile, or because too much has already been invested?
intents.description: Reviewed lenses for sunk costs, escalation, loss aversion and status-quo pressure.
